from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional

class DocumentRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document relevant to cause of action filtering."""
    document_title: str = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document as stated in the text")
    case_cause: Optional[str] = Field(description="The specific case cause (案由) explicitly stated in the document")
    document_type: Optional[str] = Field(description="The type of judicial document, e.g., 判决书，裁定书，决定书")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentRecord]
